title: **Resolve the vulnerable Vite
notes: peer used by Vitest.** Security gate reproduced GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm at
Vite 8.2.0. An ordinary transitive update retained the auto-installed
peer; the targeted Vite 8.2 override selects patched 8.2.4. Preserve
release-age and build policies, verify the full gate and security audit,
and retain the pre-existing braces waiver unchanged.
result: Pinned the Vitest auto-installed Vite peer to the patched 8.2 range in the existing override policy and regenerated the lockfile without changing the release-age or build policies. The ordinary transitive update alone had retained 8.2.0.
evidence: pnpm why vite resolves only 8.2.4; pnpm check:security now exits 0 with zero unwaived findings and the existing braces waiver unchanged. env -u DB_NAME pnpm check passes 59 tests, with 8 database integration cases skipped; type checking, lint, format, duplicate and dead-code checks pass.
